_comment: Baseline for benchmark regression detection on linux-amd64 (GitHub
Actions ubuntu-latest, ~4 vCPU). This is the gate CI enforces.
Captured via the throwaway capture-bench workflow: median of 6 runs
at -benchtime=2s on the runner. The per-package TestBenchmarkRegression
runs in CI through `make test` (TALON_BENCH=1) and compares median-of-5
Tolerance is 12% — looser than the dev baseline.darwin-arm64.json (3%)
because shared CI runners vary 10%+ run-to-run. The average-ratio gate
plus the 2x per-bench outlier safeguard still catch real regressions.
If this flakes, nudge tolerance up; if it stops catching regressions,
Recapture after deliberate perf changes: push the bench-capture branch
(temp capture-bench workflow), re-median the logged ns/op, update here.
Only the gated benchmarks need rows; ungated benches bootstrap-emit.
